scope: Release-specific package installation, upgrade and live Chromium measurements are recorded alongside the final archive in dsh-jingshen-0.4.2-verification.json.
Voice measurements do not include an external dialogue-model response. Subjective timbre is provided as a listening sample. The packaged speaker is the PrimeTTS speaker, not the Breeze library voice.
The current real-media platform is Linux local Web. No Windows, macOS, Electron, or long-term learning validation is claimed.
